SESSION 5 WHY AND HOW DO I PRAY? 
 “When I pray,  
 Coincidences happen,  
 and when I don’t,  
 they don’t.”  
WILLIAM TEMPLE,  
THE FORMER ARCHBISHOP OF CANTERBURY 
 
3. DOES GOD ALWAYS ANSWER PRAYER?  
 
• Yes—you receive what you prayed for, sometimes immediately. 
 
• No—sometimes an obvious reason why not; other times we may not understand straight 
away why the answer is no. 
 
• Wait—for the right timing. 
 
•  
4. HOW DO WE PRAY?  
• Thank you—count your blessings, not your problems. 
 
• Sorry—confess your sins (John 13:6–10). 
 
• Please—“Give us today our daily bread.” (Matthew 6:11): ask for anything you need.
